label: Proper-part extensionality and simple plurality control
paraphrase: Unrestricted proper-part extensionality identifies every pair of minimal objects. Strong supplementation implies composite-restricted proper-part extensionality. The existing full-fusion nonempty-subsets-of-Bool interpretation has two distinct minimal singleton atoms, equal empty proper-part profiles, composite-restricted extensionality and failure of unrestricted extensionality jointly. This distinguishes the identity principles; it asserts no two necessary or metaphysically simple ultimate grounds.
